findings.body: The `imp` module was deprecated in Python 3.4 and completely removed in Python 3.12. Using it will cause an `ImportError` on modern Python versions. Additionally, `imp.load_module` is considered unsafe for loading untrusted code because it does not properly handle module caching and can lead to unexpected side effects or security bypasses.
findings.title: Replace deprecated `imp` module with `importlib`

findings.body: The `imp` module was deprecated in Python 3.4 and completely removed in Python 3.12. Using it will raise an `AttributeError` on modern interpreters. Furthermore, `imp.load_module` and `imp.find_module` do not support modern packaging features like namespace packages or zip imports, and `imp.load_module` is known to cause issues with module reloading and caching.
findings.title: Replace deprecated `imp` module with `importlib`
